name: Sancode Technologies Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2016, Sancode Technologies Ltd provides technology development and technical/management consultancy services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
a) SIL is a software and product development company offering an API enabled platform and solutions for organizations to adopt technology applications
b) Company helps organizations to drive digital transformation and competitive differentiation by providing them easy to implement pre-built business logic and solution workflows, specially for finance automations.
c) Itdevelops, provides, undertakes, designs, distributes and deals in Systems and application software, undertakes offshore software development projects, digital transformation, cloud migration, advance analytics, Robotic process automation, machine learning and AI projects in all areas of application. This includes those in emerging segments like Internet and Intranet website applications, enterprise solutions software, resource 
planning, e-commerce, value added
 products and other business applications
 for corporations across the globe.

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 145 days to 50.0 days
cons: Stock is trading at 12.9 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of -9.90% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.0.39 Cr.
